remaining.summary: Chrome exercised the five locales, editor RTL and same-browser account isolation. Full linguistic proofreading of long-tail and dynamically supplied UI messages and packaged Electron QA were not performed.

resolution.summary: Added manual English, Hebrew, Arabic, German and Russian interface localization, persisted by authenticated account, with RTL chrome and an LTR editing axis. All five locales, re-login persistence and account isolation passed in Chrome. Catalog audit verified 1759 static messages. Production typecheck, scoped lint and 35 workflow regression tests passed.
